name: hud_ui_text_input_set_contents
description: HudUiTextInput::SetContents copies bounded source text into the owned input buffer, forces trailing NUL termination, and reclamps the cursor.
known_limits: Binary Ninja disassembly for 0x4b43d0 validates strncpy(self->buffer, source, self->capacity), forcing self->buffer[self->capacity - 1] to NUL, and then calling HudUiTextInput::SetCursorPosition(self->cursor).
strncpy is a runtime/provider dependency; tier S verification remains deferred to the HUD text-input class pass.
